description: Provider-free atom-runtime lifecycle scenarios with known RunStatus classifications.

tasks.prompt: Drive a native ATOM mission through compile, prepare, start, execute, and verify with successful observations.
Drive a native ATOM mission whose compile activity returns a failed observation and report its RunStatus classification.
Drive a native ATOM mission whose execute activity returns a failed observation and report its RunStatus classification.
Drive a native ATOM mission whose prepare activity returns a cancelled observation and report its RunStatus classification.
Drive a native ATOM mission whose start activity returns a blocked observation and report its RunStatus classification.
Drive a native ATOM mission whose verify activity returns a degraded observation and report its RunStatus classification.
